display.title: Episode 304: The Golden Staff, Chapter 2 (Year of Hakhel)
display.summary_short: A dive into Uncle Yossi's mailbag, the end of 'The Golden Staff' as Binyamin's golden touch turns into a nightmare, and how children can keep the mitzvah of Hakhel this year.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in Kislev 5748, a Hakhel year. The show opens with a deep dive into Uncle Yossi's overloaded mailbag: a girl's colorful drawing of her Tzivos Hashem room with a Chumash, siddur and tzedakah box, and a five-year-old's letter about lighting her own Shabbos candle for the first time, each with a prize. After the Hakochainik march, a recap recalls that Binyamin the woodchopper wished that everything he touched would turn to gold, and the Mishnah's teaching that the truly rich person is one who is happy with what he has. An eleven-year-old yeshiva boy leads the Shema. In the second and final chapter of 'The Golden Staff', the golden sticks are too heavy to carry, Binyamin selfishly refuses a neighbor's help, and when he pushes him away the neighbor turns to gold. Binyamin uses his second wish to undo everything and wakes to find it was a dream. Uncle Yossi then explains Hakhel, the gathering in the Beis HaMikdash every seventh year, and suggests children gather friends for a Shabbos party of stories, songs and brachos. The show ends with Shabbos candle time.
display.lesson: Be happy with what Hashem gives you; and gather friends together in Ahavas Yisroel, as in the mitzvah of Hakhel.
